from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split equal-sized panels at the uniform separator row.
    cut = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
               if len(set(row)) == 1 and r == h - r - 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:cut], grid[cut + 1:]
    shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected exactly one shared color")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
